# Artifact audit

The classifier below uses only source identity and URL formatting/path length cues, not the phishing model features. Holdout rows were selected by a stable registrable-domain hash.

Pooled grouped surface-only AUC before reweighting: **0.7914**. After stratum reweighting: **0.2930**. Pooled target: <= 0.60. Weights are stored in `sample_weight` in the unified parquet; data rows are not duplicated.
